We are seeking evaluators for a project that combines Search Evaluation and Linguistic Analysis. In this role, you will assess user intent, annotate search queries, classify text, and evaluate multimedia content including videos, images, and audio for relevance and quality. The ideal candidate possesses strong language proficiency, excellent analytical skills, and understanding of short-form video platforms and digital content trends.

What you will do.

  • Evaluate search results and queries for relevance, intent, and quality
  • Annotate and classify text according to detailed guidelines
  • Review short videos, images, and audio for content understanding and categorization
  • Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance)
  • Provide clear, consistent rationale and feedback to improve guidelines and models
  • Meet quality and productivity targets while following project procedures
  • Use internal tools to complete, track, and submit tasks accurately

Project Details

Engagement Type: Freelance

Rate: USD 18/hour

Estimated Hours: 15- 30 hours/week

Requirement

  • English at C1 level or higher.
  • Native or near native speaker level in French language with strong reading, writing, and listening comprehension.
  • Excellent grammar, writing, and proofreading skills.
  • Strong video and image comprehension; good hearing ability for audio tasks.
  • Solid understanding of search engines, user intent, and web content.
  • High attention to detail, consistency, and guideline adherence.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in text classification, query annotation, data labelling, or search quality evaluation.
  • Familiarity with short dramas and local short-drama culture/platform.
  • Background in linguistics, communications, media studies, or related field.
  • Comfortable working with productivity targets and iterative feedback.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Staff QE, Mobile
description: About AlphaSense : AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us. About the Team: Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search. At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves. About the Role: Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days. Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort. As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you. You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE. What Makes this a Staff role: You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why. You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team. You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time. What You’ll Do: Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android. Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you. Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision. Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk. Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds. Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead. Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt. What Success looks like: First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement. By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call. By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas. Who You Are: A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it. Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python. Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores. Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts. Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps. An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short. Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders. Bonus points: Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS). Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage. Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts). Experience across both iOS and Android. What we offer: Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company Competitive compensation package Lunch and recreational benefits Occupational health care AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination. In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works. Recruiting Scams and Fraud We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note: AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training. All official communications will come from an @ alpha-sense.com email address. If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page . If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Principal Engineer, Balance of Plant Auxiliary Systems
description: Company Overview Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables. Job Summary Kairos Power is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer to lead the technical deployment of KP-FHR balance of plant (BOP) auxiliary systems engineering, including service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems. Reporting to the Balance of Plant (Power Generation System and Turbine Island) Leader, you will develop technical design solutions to enable the rapid deployment and integration of KP-FHR Balance of Plant Structures, Systems and Components (SSCs). This role requires a senior individual contributor with extensive experience in thermal and balance of plant technologies to ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation of the plant's balance of plant auxiliary systems. Responsibilities Drive the design and deployment of the balance of plant auxiliary systems, focusing on service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems including pumps, valves, and related auxiliary systems that meet Kairos Power’s FHR deployment objectives. Manage and coordinate external partners, suppliers, regulators and vendors related to BOP auxiliary systems. Support supplier technical oversight, including review of supplier deliverables, technical deviations, test plans, and component qualification evidence while performing independent verification calculations as necessary. Develop and approve system documentation deliverables as required by the project. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate the balance of plant auxiliary systems with overall plant design and operations. Lead or support formal design reviews, interface reviews, hazard reviews, and technical readiness reviews for balance of plant components and subsystems. Apply engineering principles and engineering codes & standards, such as ASME and ANSI, to the design, analysis, and evaluation of systems. Lead design trade studies, performance analyses and optimization of balance of plant auxiliary systems to meet commercial and regulatory needs. Oversee the preparation of technical specifications, design documents, and system drawings for all balance of plant auxiliary systems components. Perform feasibility studies and risk assessments related to commercial balance of plant auxiliary systems technologies and subsystems. Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of technical concepts and strategies. Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of the balance of plant auxiliary systems during the plant's startup phase. Stay abreast of industry advancements, best practices, and emerging balance of plant technologies. Develop and maintain system requirements, interface control documents, design bases, and verification/validation plans for balance of plant components. Perform work within established scope, budgetary and schedule requirements. Resolve complex technical issues and system/interface conflicts affecting BOP auxiliary system design, procurement, installation, testing, or commissioning. Evaluate proposed design changes and technical deviations for impact on system requirements, interfaces, design basis, safety, quality, and configuration control. Establish and maintain technical acceptance criteria for BOP auxiliary system components and subsystems, including criteria used for procurement, testing, and verification. Provide technical disposition and recommendations for nonconforming conditions, test results, or equipment performance issues within assigned BOP systems. Ensure design decisions, analyses, and technical resolutions are documented and traceable to applicable requirements, design inputs, and verification evidence. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications M.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or a related field 10+ years experience in the design and operation of balance of plant systems, particularly in the nuclear or thermal power sectors Demonstrated experience in managing complex engineering projects and leading technical teams, with thorough understanding of evaluation, design, and licensing of a new technology Demonstrated experience of physical hardware deployment in heat transfer and water treatment systems Experience with requirements management, systems engineering, or design control processes for complex engineered systems. Experience reviewing or developing technical specifications, procurement documents, test plans, or acceptance criteria for major equipment. Experience applying engineering codes and standards relevant to BOP auxiliary systems, including applicable ASME, ASTM, ICC, ISO, and MSS standards. Experience with one or more of the following is preferred: Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Demonstrated vendor engagement and management skills Strong understanding of heat transfer principles, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics as they relate to balance of plant systems Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for balance of plant systems. Experience with nuclear power applications is a plus. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of optimizing system performance in novel applications Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills; must be able to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization including external partners Ability to work with a highly collaborative team Ability to solve problems quickly and efficiently Prioritizes and demonstrates a nuclear safety culture Ability to proactively collect, manage and transfer knowledge Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges, and issues Knowledge of system integration, interface management, and verification/validation practices. Ability to apply safety, quality, and configuration management principles to engineering design activities. Ability to apply engineering judgment to evaluate design alternatives, technical risks, and trade-offs and develop defensible technical recommendations. Knowledge of requirements development, allocation, traceability, and verification for complex engineered systems. Ability to evaluate technical specifications, supplier deliverables, test plans, deviations, and qualification evidence against design requirements and acceptance criteria. Ability to interpret and apply applicable engineering codes, standards, and design criteria to BOP system and component design. Physical Demands Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another Communicating with others to exchange information Environmental Conditions General office environment Prototyping/Testing environment Manufacturing/Industrial Environment Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced Safety and PPE Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes, etc. Travel Some travel may be required, up to 25% Additional Requirements Requires occasional schedule flexibility Requires occasional extended hours to support testing, commissioning, and critical project timeline The salary range for this position is $175,019 to $218,774 for employees working onsite at our Alameda, CA headquarters. The range provided in this job posting represents the typical range or starting rate of candidates hired in California. title: Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass
description: Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling. As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise. Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter , which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end. This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments. You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed. You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself. We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world. You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow. If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk. ABOUT YOU You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code. You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live. You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution. You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed. You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful. Required Skills and Experience Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems. Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments. Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed. SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows. Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure. Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform. End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate. Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation. Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments. AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality. Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight. Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East. Bonus Points for Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product. Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems. Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure. Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language. Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description. Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments. Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product. WHAT WE OFFER Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio. High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it. End-to-end responsibility: Own your work from architecture and implementation through deployment, integration, and ongoing operation. Real-world problems: Work on complex engineering and data problems within airline revenue management, where the software you build directly supports business decisions. Direct product exposure: Work closely with the people using what you build and bring those insights back into technical and product decisions. Product influence: Help shape Curveglass's architecture, roadmap, and approach to client-specific versus shared product functionality. Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems. Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community. Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement. Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company. Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

title: Software Engineer III | Framework
description: At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Position Summary As a Software Engineer III, you will drive key architectural and technical decisions, lead the design and execution of complex engineering initiatives, and elevate technical standards across the Framework team. You’ll partner closely with principal engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure systems that power core ExtraHop products. This role is designed for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong ownership and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration. Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes.Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB. This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. You will work on next generation initiatives including scaling and performance improvement efforts, evolution of our data storage architecture (custom to open-source based) and early steps towards a cloud enabled model. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for ExtraHop's core Framework systems, taking ownership of moderately complex to complex features with limited guidance. Work across networking layers to implement and enhance protocol support Participate actively in technical design discussions, contribute to architecture decisions within your team, and author clear technical documentation for your work. Engage fully in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives; hold a high bar for code quality and test coverage. Collaborate with Product and cross-functional engineering partners such as platform , infrastructure and cloud teams to to define technical roadmaps, break down ambiguous problems, and balance technical debt with delivery. Investigate, diagnose, and resolve production and performance issues independently; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures. Contribute to platform modernization efforts and help evaluate and adopt new technologies or frameworks in partnership with senior and principal engineers. Participate in on-call rotations and improve system observability, reliability and operational readiness. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in STEM field, Computer Science, Engineering, or related degree requiring systematic/analytical thinking 4+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems at scale Strong expertise in C and C++ Experience developing on Linux Systems (multi threading, memory management, IPC etc) Proven ability to build and maintain performance critical systems. Proven ability to debug complex issues (eg. using gdb, coredumps, performance tools) Strong understanding of networking fundamentals Strong command of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, with the ability to decompose complex problems into clear, actionable engineering tasks. Self-starter who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight. Excellent collaborator and communicator with a growth mindset and customer-first orientation. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience with network protocols (eg. HTTP, SMB, Kerberos, TLS, Microsoft protocols or similar) Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or distributed systems Experience with observability, on-call practices and production systems Scripting experience (Python or similar) Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more. ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. OUR VALUES Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done. Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo. Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. BENEFITS Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. title: Staff Software Engineer, Performance- Weights & Biases
description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com . Weights & Biases at CoreWeave CoreWeave acquired Weights & Biases to create the most powerful end-to-end platform to develop, deploy, and iterate AI faster. CoreWeave operates a growing footprint of data centers covering every region of the US and across Europe, and was ranked as one of the TIME100 most influential companies of 2024. By bringing together CoreWeave’s industry-leading cloud infrastructure with the best-in-class tools AI practitioners know and love from Weights & Biases, we’re setting a new standard for how AI is built, trained, and scaled. The integration of our teams and technologies is accelerating our shared mission: to empower developers with the tools and infrastructure they need to push the boundaries of what AI can do. From experiment tracking and model optimization to high-performance training clusters, agent building, and inference at scale, we’re combining forces to serve the full AI lifecycle — all in one seamless platform. Weights & Biases has long been trusted by over 1,500 organizations — including AstraZeneca, Canva, Cohere, OpenAI, Meta, Snowflake, Square, Toyota, and Wayve — to build better models, AI agents and applications. Now, as part of CoreWeave, that impact is amplified across a broader ecosystem of AI innovators, researchers, and enterprises. As we unite under one vision, we’re looking for bold thinkers and agile builders who are excited to shape the future of AI alongside us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our team. What You’ll Do: Performance Engineering at Weights & Biases ensures our systems and products scale seamlessly as usage grows. We embed performance thinking into every stage of development—diagnosing issues, designing scalable patterns, and building tools that empower every engineering team to deliver fast, efficient, and reliable experiences. Our mission is to make performance a shared responsibility across the company through data, automation, and collaboration. About the role: As a Staff Engineer on the Performance Engineering team, you’ll take technical ownership of complex performance challenges across the W&B platform and infrastructure. You’ll design and lead experiments to improve system scalability and latency, develop standardized benchmarking and load testing frameworks, and drive initiatives to prevent regressions across product surfaces. You’ll collaborate closely with product, infrastructure, and SRE teams, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic understanding of system behavior. Day to day, you’ll blend investigation, architecture, and enablement—helping teams measure, understand, and continuously improve performance. Who You Are: 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, with at least 2 years focused on performance optimization, systems scalability, or observability. Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript, with strong systems-level debugging and profiling skills. Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts (caching, queuing, concurrency, resource contention, etc.) and their performance implications. Experience designing and implementing load testing, benchmarking, or performance regression frameworks (e.g., Locust, Gatling, k6, custom solutions). Familiarity with metrics and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, etc.) and performance data analysis. Experience integrating performance measurement into CI/CD pipelines. Ability to design experiments, analyze large datasets, and draw actionable conclusions. Proven track record of driving cross-functional technical initiatives from design through adoption. Preferred: Prior experience in performance engineering or SRE at scale (e.g., supporting multi-region, high-throughput systems). Familiarity with frontend performance monitoring and web vitals. Experience building developer-facing tools or frameworks. Background in data systems, observability, or ML infrastructure. Experience contributing to open-source performance or benchmarking tools. Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. You love to turn messy, complex performance problems into clear, data-backed stories that lead to concrete action. You’re curious about how systems behave under real-world load and enjoy building experiments that reveal what’s really happening under the hood. You’re an expert in transforming deep technical insights into tools and processes that empower other engineers to build faster, more reliable systems. You find satisfaction in long-term, cross-team collaboration — helping others succeed by embedding performance thinking into their workflows. You get energy from bridging theory and practice: designing scalable architectures and writing the code that proves them out. You care deeply about measurement, iteration, and continuous improvement — not just fixing bottlenecks, but preventing them from ever recurring. Why Us? We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: Be Curious at Your Core Act Like an Owner Empower Employees Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences Achieve More Together We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

Weights & Biases at CoreWeave

CoreWeave acquired Weights & Biases to create the most powerful end-to-end platform to develop, deploy, and iterate AI faster. CoreWeave operates a growing footprint of data centers covering every region of the US and across Europe, and was ranked as one of the TIME100 most influential companies of 2024. By bringing together CoreWeave’s industry-leading cloud infrastructure with the best-in-class tools AI practitioners know and love from Weights & Biases, we’re setting a new standard for how AI is built, trained, and scaled.

The integration of our teams and technologies is accelerating our shared mission: to empower developers with the tools and infrastructure they need to push the boundaries of what AI can do. From experiment tracking and model optimization to high-performance training clusters, agent building, and inference at scale, we’re combining forces to serve the full AI lifecycle — all in one seamless platform.

Weights & Biases has long been trusted by over 1,500 organizations — including AstraZeneca, Canva, Cohere, OpenAI, Meta, Snowflake, Square, Toyota, and Wayve — to build better models, AI agents and applications. Now, as part of CoreWeave, that impact is amplified across a broader ecosystem of AI innovators, researchers, and enterprises.

As we unite under one vision, we’re looking for bold thinkers and agile builders who are excited to shape the future of AI alongside us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our team.

What You’ll Do:

Performance Engineering at Weights & Biases ensures our systems and products scale seamlessly as usage grows. We embed performance thinking into every stage of development—diagnosing issues, designing scalable patterns, and building tools that empower every engineering team to deliver fast, efficient, and reliable experiences. Our mission is to make performance a shared responsibility across the company through data, automation, and collaboration.

About the role:

As a Staff Engineer on the Performance Engineering team, you’ll take technical ownership of complex performance challenges across the W&B platform and infrastructure. You’ll design and lead experiments to improve system scalability and latency, develop standardized benchmarking and load testing frameworks, and drive initiatives to prevent regressions across product surfaces. You’ll collaborate closely with product, infrastructure, and SRE teams, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic understanding of system behavior. Day to day, you’ll blend investigation, architecture, and enablement—helping teams measure, understand, and continuously improve performance.

Who You Are:

  • 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, with at least 2 years focused on performance optimization, systems scalability, or observability.
  • Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript, with strong systems-level debugging and profiling skills.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts (caching, queuing, concurrency, resource contention, etc.) and their performance implications.
  • Experience designing and implementing load testing, benchmarking, or performance regression frameworks (e.g., Locust, Gatling, k6, custom solutions).
  • Familiarity with metrics and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, etc.) and performance data analysis.
  • Experience integrating performance measurement into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to design experiments, analyze large datasets, and draw actionable conclusions.
  • Proven track record of driving cross-functional technical initiatives from design through adoption.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience in performance engineering or SRE at scale (e.g., supporting multi-region, high-throughput systems).
  • Familiarity with frontend performance monitoring and web vitals.
  • Experience building developer-facing tools or frameworks.
  • Background in data systems, observability, or ML infrastructure.
  • Experience contributing to open-source performance or benchmarking tools.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You love to turn messy, complex performance problems into clear, data-backed stories that lead to concrete action.
  • You’re curious about how systems behave under real-world load and enjoy building experiments that reveal what’s really happening under the hood.
  • You’re an expert in transforming deep technical insights into tools and processes that empower other engineers to build faster, more reliable systems.
  • You find satisfaction in long-term, cross-team collaboration — helping others succeed by embedding performance thinking into their workflows.
  • You get energy from bridging theory and practice: designing scalable architectures and writing the code that proves them out.
  • You care deeply about measurement, iteration, and continuous improvement — not just fixing bottlenecks, but preventing them from ever recurring.

Why Us?

We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

description: Job Title: Senior Product Engineer. Department: Engineering. Type: Full-Time Reports To: Head of Engineering. Hours: 40/week. Teachstone® was founded in 2008 to deliver the Classroom Assessment Scoring System® (CLASS®) nationwide and around the globe. Developed through years of research, the CLASS observation tool measures the interactions between teachers and children, which have been shown to drive learning and lifelong achievement. Teachstone helps organizations conduct classroom observations and provides professional development so that teachers improve, and children learn more. Our online subscription service, myTeachstone, simplifies CLASS implementation by combining observation data with a robust library of CLASS resources and professional development. At Teachstone, everything we do is about improving the ways teachers interact with their students. We train coaches and observers, build and deliver online support programs, and design professional development—all grounded in one proven fact: the interactions teachers have with students have a lasting impact on their academic and developmental success. By helping educators describe, measure, and improve their interactions and relationships with students, Teachstone is transforming education nationwide, one interaction at a time. Role Overview Teachstone is seeking an experienced, hands-on engineer to help shape and deliver the next generation of our technology platform. This role prioritizes product opportunities from initial problem definition through design, development, and production, with a particular emphasis on building AI-enabled capabilities as an integral part of the product experience. Working across frontend, backend, APIs, data models, and infrastructure, this individual will translate evolving business and customer needs into scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. Strong full-stack engineering capabilities, including the ability to work hands-on across application code, infrastructure, and unfamiliar technology systems. Demonstrated ability to translate loosely defined business problems and customer requirements into technical solutions and shipped products without relying on fully documented specifications. Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development workflows, with the ability to evaluate their strengths, limitations, and appropriate applications. This includes medical and dental insurance, 401(k), paid time off, insurance coverage, and professional development opportunities. Additional details will be provided at the time of offer. Benefit eligibility depends on your role and employment status. Ready to Make a Difference? At Teachstone, we believe that every interaction shapes a brighter future. description: About us Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets. About the role Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers. Here's what you will do Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models Here's the background we hope you will have 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization. Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python. Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures The following would be nice to have, but is not required Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency What we offer The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware. A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package Compensation Additional Information At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role

Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers.

Here's what you will do

  • Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation
  • Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies
  • Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together
  • Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems
  • Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models

Here's the background we hope you will have

  • 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization.
  • Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python.
  • Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation
  • Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

  • Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus
  • Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation
  • Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning
  • Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus
  • Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency

What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware.
  • A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture
  • A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

raw.jobDescription:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to our Identity Foundations (IDF) team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

We’re looking for an autonomous and resourceful engineer to join our international Identity Foundations (IDF) team, which owns critical services at the heart of our product—including our login engine, session management, and single sign-on (SSO). You’ll build features that sit at the spine of the platform, powering experiences used by millions of users while tackling complex engineering challenges around performance, reliability, and multi-region scalability. You’ll also play a key role in driving our AI transformation, leveraging AI-assisted development to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and build seamless, reliable identity foundations.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own end-to-end projects from technical design through implementation, rollout, and production operation—impacting critical red-route authentication workflows for users, clients, and partners through heavy testing, organization, and strategic execution.
  • Build and evolve maintainable, reliable, and scalable backend services that operate at massive scale across different regions, continuously identifying ways to improve production systems.
  • Drive our AI transformation by leveraging LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and elevate problem-solving workflows.
  • Author technical documentation, such as RFCs, to articulate architectural ideas, share knowledge, and actively engage in reviewing peers' proposals.
  • Deliver committed initiatives across tactical cycles to help the company achieve its core strategic goals.
  • Champion a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture by monitoring rollouts, guaranteeing quality through comprehensive testing, and responding effectively to bugs and production incidents.
  • Collaborate within an agile, people-first environment by exchanging constructive feedback on growth, successes, and mistakes to help your team develop professionally and foster a great place to work.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced backend engineer with years of experience building and operating production backend systems, with expertise in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang highly desirable.
  • A distributed systems specialist with strong experience designing and scaling APIs, data-intensive applications, cloud-native architectures on platforms like AWS, and scalable databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • A cloud-native practitioner with hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and operating services in production using Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms, alongside Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision components like databases, caches, lambdas, and CDN configurations.
  • An infrastructure and reliability-minded builder experienced in asynchronous processing using message brokers (such as Kafka, SQS/SNS, or RabbitMQ) and production observability tools (such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus).
  • An AI-fluent technologist who thoughtfully leverages modern LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to enhance engineering workflows and solve complex technical problems.
  • An autonomous, end-to-end owner who makes thoughtful technical decisions, embraces a "you build it, you run it" mindset, and independently drives projects from design to production operation.
  • A clear and confident communicator who thrives in collaborative, agile environments that prioritize people over process—comfortable influencing technical decisions, sharing ideas across teams, and giving and receiving constructive feedback.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead - NetBox Core
description: NetBox Labs is seeking a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead for NetBox Core, a team in our Applications group. NetBox is a product that reaches people in a few ways: our open source community runs NetBox OSS; commercial customers use NetBox Cloud (SaaS) or NetBox Enterprise (self-managed). NetBox Core builds NetBox and its core plugins, the code that runs everywhere NetBox runs. We work closely with NetBox Delivery, the team that ships NetBox and runs it on Cloud and Enterprise. As Tech Lead, you set the technical direction for NetBox Core and stay hands-on in the code. You bring deep Django and Python skills, experience running Django in production SaaS at scale, and a good understanding of Kubernetes and SRE practices. In this role you will: Design and build NetBox and its core plugins, across the data model, business logic, APIs, and integrations Own the technical direction and architecture of NetBox and its core plugins, as the team's primary technical decision maker Keep NetBox fast and reliable as data and usage grow, from query performance to background jobs Drive NetBox releases, including versioning, release notes, and the release cadence Lead and mentor the team's engineers through design and code review, and set the team's standards for testing and documentation Take part in community contributions and public design discussions on GitHub Work with NetBox Delivery and the Cloud, Enterprise, and Foundations teams to build observability into NetBox, define release contracts, and drive cross-team changes through RFCs Act as a technical escalation point during incidents and make sure postmortem actions get done Requirements: 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a production system or platform area Deep Python and Django expertise, including running a Django SaaS application in production at scale A track record of finding and fixing Django performance problems, including ORM query optimization, Postgres indexing and query plans, schema design, and migration risk on large tables Production experience with background job queues such as RQ or Celery, and message brokers such as Redis or RabbitMQ Experience building observability into applications, including error reporting, distributed tracing, metrics, and structured raw.jobDescription:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead for NetBox Core, a team in our Applications group.

NetBox is a product that reaches people in a few ways: our open source community runs NetBox OSS; commercial customers use NetBox Cloud (SaaS) or NetBox Enterprise (self-managed). NetBox Core builds NetBox and its core plugins, the code that runs everywhere NetBox runs. We work closely with NetBox Delivery, the team that ships NetBox and runs it on Cloud and Enterprise.

As Tech Lead, you set the technical direction for NetBox Core and stay hands-on in the code. You bring deep Django and Python skills, experience running Django in production SaaS at scale, and a good understanding of Kubernetes and SRE practices.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build NetBox and its core plugins, across the data model, business logic, APIs, and integrations

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of NetBox and its core plugins, as the team's primary technical decision maker

  • Keep NetBox fast and reliable as data and usage grow, from query performance to background jobs

  • Drive NetBox releases, including versioning, release notes, and the release cadence

  • Lead and mentor the team's engineers through design and code review, and set the team's standards for testing and documentation

  • Take part in community contributions and public design discussions on GitHub

  • Work with NetBox Delivery and the Cloud, Enterprise, and Foundations teams to build observability into NetBox, define release contracts, and drive cross-team changes through RFCs

  • Act as a technical escalation point during incidents and make sure postmortem actions get done

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a production system or platform area

  • Deep Python and Django expertise, including running a Django SaaS application in production at scale

  • A track record of finding and fixing Django performance problems, including ORM query optimization, Postgres indexing and query plans, schema design, and migration risk on large tables

  • Production experience with background job queues such as RQ or Celery, and message brokers such as Redis or RabbitMQ

  • Experience building observability into applications, including error reporting, distributed tracing, metrics, and structured logging, with tools such as OpenTelemetry and Sentry

  • A working understanding of how Python applications run on Kubernetes, and of SRE practices such as SLOs, incident response, and postmortems

  • Experience leading engineering work without formal manager authority, including mentoring other engineers

  • Hands-on experience building inside an AI-augmented development harness, including Claude Code and the workflows that make agentic tooling reliable

  • A track record of making technical decisions under ambiguity and driving work across team boundaries, from writing the RFC to getting a cross-team migration done

  • Comfort working in the open, including discussing designs in public issues, reviewing community contributions, and writing user-facing documentation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience building deep inside Django's internals, such as the app registry, model metadata, and the schema editor, for example to create models at runtime as our Custom Objects plugin does

  • Experience with the parts of the Django ecosystem NetBox uses, such as Django REST Framework, GraphQL with Strawberry, django-filter, and django-mptt

  • Experience with advanced Postgres features, such as schemas for multi-tenancy or branching, advisory locks, and connection pooling

  • Hands-on experience with several tools in our delivery stack: AWS, Kubernetes and Helm, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD or FluxCD, Terraform, and Prometheus and Grafana

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup or high-growth organization

  • Familiarity with the NetBox ecosystem or network automation

  • Contributions to or maintenance of an open source project

  • Experience with self-managed or on-premises delivery

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Job Title: Senior Software Engineer Location: USA (Remote or Regional Office) Reports To: Senior VP of Engineering About Cyware: Cyware delivers an innovative approach to cybersecurity that unifies threat intelligence, automation, threat response, and vulnerability management with data insights gleaned from assets, users, malware, attackers, and vulnerabilities. Cyware is widely deployed by enterprises, government agencies, and MSSPs, and is the leading threat intelligence sharing platform for global ISACs and CERTs. Your next opportunity starts here! More on Cyware: ( www.cyware.com ) Built and designed by SecOps practitioners and cybersecurity leaders, Cyware offers multiple technologies within its Cyber Fusion platform, including advanced threat intelligence solutions (TIP) for large and small security teams, vendor-agnostic security automation (SOAR), and purpose-built security case management. As a result, organizations can increase speed and accuracy while reducing costs and analyst burnout. Cyware's Virtual Cyber Fusion solutions make secure collaboration, information sharing, and enhanced threat visibility a reality for enterprises, sharing communities (ISAC/ISAO), MSSPs, and government agencies of all sizes and needs. About you: You are driven, inquisitive, proactive, and energetic You have a growth mindset and are committed to delivering results You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment You understand that building high-quality products means adhering to a high bar where security, auditability, and reliability are not afterthoughts You have experience with AI-based debugging and development tools and practices Why We’re Hiring We are looking for a passionate back-end developer to build and harden Cyware's Cyber Fusion platform across both commercial enterprise and public sector environments. You will build scalable features that seamlessly operate within commercial SaaS and highly regulated compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Moderate, deployed across standard cloud infrastructure and AWS GovCloud. You'll work closely with our Security, GRC, and DevOps teams to ensure every feature you ship is deployable, auditable, and defensible under rigorous commercial and federal compliance standards. Come join an exciting cybersecurity product startup that just closed Series C funding round! What You’ll Do Develop features from proposal to polished end result, accounting for both enterprise scale and high-security compliance constraints (GovCloud, segmented environments, control inheritance) from design forward. Build code that passes FedRAMP/GovRAMP control requirements (secure coding, audit logging, RBAC, encryption in transit/at rest) without needing significant post-hoc rework. Manage and review code contributed by the rest of the team, with an eye toward what will meet rigorous enterprise and regulatory security standards, and keep code easy to maintain and easy for others to contribute to. Partner with DevOps and GRC to ensure features deploy cleanly through modern CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, Helm, ArgoCD) across commercial and GovCloud environments, holding up under continuous monitoring. Take initiative in improving the software in small or large ways to address pain points in your own experience as a developer. Work with multi-disciplinary teams to maintain and support production and operations of Cyware Products across both commercial and GovCloud environments. Who You Are U.S. Citizenship required (per 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(2)(C)); ability to comply with U.S. government/enterprise security standards, and eligibility for security clearances. Bachelor’s degree or higher, in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related discipline (or equivalent experience). 7–10+ years of Python experience, proficient in building efficient REST APIs with Django/Django REST Framework; 5+ years of practical experience in building Django applications is a huge plus. Go (GoLang) is a strong plus. Strong software design and architecture skills with proven experience designing scalable microservices and applying core design principles (e.g., MVC), including understanding of OOPS and design patterns such as strategy and adapter to build modular and scalable solutions. Solid background with Generative AI integrations, REST/gRPC LLM services, AI agents, and RAG pipelines (vector stores, embeddings, document indexing, retrieval strategies). Hands-on experience in AWS and AWS GovCloud environments (ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS) and multi-tenant architectures. Proficiency with enterprise & federal identity/auth standards (SAML, OAuth, PIV/CAC, FICAM, RBAC) and secure coding principles (OWASP, secrets management) aligned with FedRAMP/GovRAMP controls. Practical knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, MongoDB), RDBMS and NoSQL use cases, caching (Redis, Memcached), and message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis). Strong engineering practices including unit testing, debugging, test automation, CI/CD, source version control, Git/GitHub, and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of scheduling frameworks or event-driven programming in Django, threading limitations of Python, and multi-process architecture. Experience with applications that have scaled, including designing scalable microservices and building products from scratch; prior experience in search-heavy, data-intensive, or AI-powered products is a big plus. Strong proficiency in data structures and algorithms and good understanding of server-side templating languages. Knowledge of user authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments, including RBAC controls and multi-tenant architectures. Good hands-on experience working in scalable AWS environments and understanding of associated cloud services and application architectures. Experience with Elasticsearch for search, log analytics, or as part of an indexing layer is a strong plus. Knowledge of different database technologies and associated use cases, caching mechanisms using Redis/Memcache, and message brokers like RabbitMQ, Kafka, and Redis. Self-driven approach to enjoy technical challenges and eagerness to explore new technologies (AI, LLMs, RAG, Go, etc.), with experience developing products from scratch in regulated/FedRAMP environments.
